reason: Extends user_platform_quotas.platform so Grok default platform quotas can be persisted during signup and OAuth pending completion.
risk: The migration drops and recreates a CHECK constraint on user_platform_quotas, which can briefly lock the table while PostgreSQL validates the replacement constraint.
mitigation: The new constraint is a superset of the old allowed values, so existing rows remain valid and older code remains compatible with the widened CHECK. Deploy only after the Grok quota compatibility commit is active, during the normal dev deploy window with existing health checks in place.
